text: Ocean tides are caused mainly by the gravitational pull of the Moon, with the Sun contributing a smaller effect. When the Moon, Earth and Sun align, spring tides occur, producing a larger tidal range. When the Moon and Sun pull at right angles, neap tides occur, producing a smaller range.
title: Tides

text: Photosynthesis is the process by which green plants convert sunlight, water and carbon dioxide into glucose and oxygen. It takes place mainly in the leaves, inside organelles called chloroplasts, which contain the pigment chlorophyll.
title: Photosynthesis

text: Honeybees communicate the location of food with a waggle dance. The angle of the dance relative to vertical indicates direction relative to the Sun, and the duration of the waggle run indicates distance to the food source.
title: Bee communication

text: A volcano forms where molten rock from below the Earth's crust erupts at the surface. Eruptions can produce lava flows, ash clouds and gases. Shield volcanoes, built from runny lava, have gentle slopes, while stratovolcanoes, built from alternating lava and ash, are steeper.
title: Volcanoes

text: The seasons are caused by the tilt of the Earth's axis relative to its orbit around the Sun, not by changes in the Earth's distance from the Sun. When a hemisphere is tilted towards the Sun it receives more direct sunlight and experiences summer.
title: Seasons

text: A solar eclipse occurs when the Moon passes between the Earth and the Sun and blocks sunlight. A lunar eclipse occurs when the Earth passes between the Sun and the Moon and casts its shadow on the Moon.
title: Eclipses

text: The water cycle describes how water evaporates from oceans, lakes and land, condenses into clouds, falls as precipitation, and collects again. Plants also release water vapour through transpiration.
title: Water cycle

text: A magnet has two poles, north and south. Like poles repel each other and unlike poles attract. The Earth itself acts like a giant magnet, which is why a compass needle points roughly north.
title: Magnetism

text: Evolution by natural selection occurs when individuals with traits better suited to their environment are more likely to survive and reproduce, so those traits become more common in the population over generations.
title: Evolution

text: The phases of the Moon are caused by the changing angles at which sunlight illuminates the Moon as seen from Earth. A full moon occurs when the side facing Earth is fully lit, and a new moon occurs when that side is in shadow.
title: Moon phases

text: A solar eclipse occurs when the Moon passes directly between the Earth and the Sun, blocking sunlight from reaching part of the Earth. It can only happen during a new moon, when the Moon is on the same side of the Earth as the Sun.
title: Solar eclipse

text: A lunar eclipse occurs when the Earth passes directly between the Sun and the Moon, casting the Earth's shadow on the Moon. It can only happen during a full moon, when the Moon is on the opposite side of the Earth from the Sun.
title: Lunar eclipse

text: Spring tides occur when the Moon, Earth and Sun are aligned in a straight line. The combined gravitational pull produces a larger tidal range, with higher high tides and lower low tides.
title: Spring tides

text: Neap tides occur when the Moon and Sun pull on the Earth at right angles to each other. Their gravitational effects partly cancel, producing a smaller tidal range.
title: Neap tides

text: Cellular respiration is the process by which cells release energy from glucose, using oxygen and producing carbon dioxide and water. It takes place mainly in the mitochondria, the organelles that generate most of a cell's energy.
title: Cellular respiration

text: Shield volcanoes are built from runny, low-viscosity lava that flows easily and spreads widely. They have broad, gentle slopes and eruptions that are usually less explosive than those of steep volcanoes.
title: Shield volcano

text: Stratovolcanoes are built from alternating layers of lava and ash. They have steep, conical slopes and eruptions that can be highly explosive, producing ash clouds and fast-moving flows.
title: Stratovolcano

text: Chemosynthesis is a process used by some bacteria to make food without sunlight. Instead of light energy, these organisms use energy from chemical reactions, often involving sulfur compounds near deep-sea vents.
title: Chemosynthesis

text: An adaptation is a trait that helps an organism survive and reproduce in its environment, such as thick fur in cold climates. Adaptations arise through natural selection over generations, but a single adaptation is not the same as the whole process of evolution.
title: Adaptation

text: A new moon occurs when the side of the Moon facing the Earth is not illuminated by sunlight, so the Moon appears dark from Earth. This happens when the Moon is between the Earth and the Sun.
title: New moon
